engine: Saisei's grid skeleton — the next page's vertical column RULES stroke in (scaleY 0->1) on the interstitial, drawing the incoming page's layout grid before the content arrives ('the page sketches its skeleton'). Harvested from D_saisei (S3).

measured_teardown.move: draw() injects vertical rules at given x% positions, each transform-origin centre (or top), scaleY 0->1, staggered; undraw() reverses (recede to the edge).
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei interstitial: vertical column rules (margins ~7%/93% + inner thirds) stroke in top->down / centre-out under the cream loader, then recede.

entry: GridSkeletonDraw.create(target, opts) -> { draw(), undraw(), set(p), rules, destroy }. Injects vertical rules into the target; draw() strokes them in (scaleY 0->1 staggered), undraw() recedes them, set(p) scrubs.
law: transform(scaleY) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> shown. owns_pin false. Pairs UNDER a monogram-ring-loader on the interstitial.
gate_mode: triggered (not scroll), DOM rules (no ) — wheel gate doesn't apply. Verify the rules stroke in scaleY 0->1 staggered, smoothly.
proven: lab: OUR cream interstitial with 木 — 5 vertical rules stroke in (scaleY 0->1, centre-origin, staggered) sketching the grid. Probe (4x throttle): 0% long frames, 59.9fps.
